item.title: Road upgrades, police outpost planned for new LBI housing scheme
item.description: Residents of the new housing development at La Bonne Intention (LBI), East Coast Demerara (ECD), are set to benefit from a series of infrastructure and community improvements, including road upgrades, a police outpost, improved street lighting, and recreational facilities. item.title: One arrested over alleged cattle theft on East Coast
item.description: A 44-year-old man has been arrested as investigators probe the alleged theft of two heifers from a pasture at Bachelor’s Adventure, East Coast Demerara (ECD). The incident reportedly occurred between about 5:30 pm on Saturday, March 14, 2026, and 6:00 am on Monday, March 16, 2026, and involved a 61-year-old farmer of Melanie Railway Embankment, East Coast Demerara. item.description: By: Christal YongMinister of Home Affairs Oneidge Walrond says the government, through the Ministries of Home Affairs and Education, is developing a comprehensive plan to address the issue of students bringing dangerous items into schools. item.title: Nearly 100 Cuban medical professionals employed in Guyana on same pay scale as locals
item.description: By: Dinley RaphaelClose to 100 Cuban medical professionals are employed across Guyana’s healthcare system, and according to Minister of Health Dr. Frank Anthony, they are being paid the same salaries as their Guyanese counterparts. item.title: CANU warns public after suspected cannabis-infused drinks seized at CJIA
item.description: The Customs Anti Narcotic Unit (CANU) has issued a public alert following the interception of 222 cans of suspected THC-laced beverages at the Cheddi Jagan International Airport. The seizure was made on Wednesday through the Guyana Early Warning System (EWS) after the drinks were reportedly discovered hidden in storage bins packed with clothing, paper bags, and other assorted items.
